station_name: BASS LAKE NEAR BASS LAKE, CALIF.
township_range_section: NE¼ sec.26, T.7 S., R.22 E.
notes: Monthend contents, one value per printed date row: Sept. 30 (1971) through Sept. 30 (1972) = 13 values. Title says water year October 1971 to September 1972; first row (Sept. 30) is the end of the previous water year, so start date is taken from the printed rows. Location text also: at outlet tower at dam on North Fork Willow Creek, 2.2 miles southeast of town of Bass Lake, and 5 miles north of town of North Fork; Sierra National Forest. Formerly called Crane Valley Reservoir. Dam completed 1901 (not a well, so construction_date blank).
